integrity.critical_source_input: arXiv:2609.37634v1 supplies the exact Mayer--Vietoris simplicial resolution, the simple-normal-crossings theorem, the projective-space rational parametrization of every nonempty stratum, and the convex-cover proof that K_a is contractible for |a|<=r.
integrity.proof_status: The accepted claim is derived by independently combining those inputs with the standard vanishing of higher structure-sheaf cohomology for smooth projective unirational complex varieties. No finite computation substitutes for the universal proof.

scientific_limitations: The proof is over the complex numbers and uses characteristic-zero Hodge theory for smooth projective unirational strata.
The conclusion concerns the structure sheaf and the dual complex; it does not construct a flat degeneration to the small diagonal.
An exact-title bibliographic record for a 2026 doctoral thesis on linked projective spaces was located, but its full text was not accessible in the searches used here.
title: Structure-sheaf acyclicity of linked projective spaces
